snp2.13:1.4: SnA maintains that this sutta took place on the same day as the Mahāsamaya Sutta (The Great Meeting, DN 20).
snp2.13:2.3: DN 2 lists various forms of fortune telling dealing with omens, meteors, dreams, and marks as types of wrong livelihood for a monk.
snp2.13:14.1: See Ud 5:5 and Thag 6:13: ‘Rain soddens what’s covered & doesn’t sodden what’s open. So open up what’s covered up, so that it won’t get soddened by the rain.’
snp2.13:17.3: Reading sabba-saṁyojaniye vītivatto with the Thai edition. The Burmese edition reads sabba-saṁyojanayoga vīticatto, ‘totally released from all yoking to fetters.’
